cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The small trophy is better. It shows restraint.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.
